features.feature_value: Heavy use of ellipses and exclamatory punctuation for emphasis
features.evidence_span: "taking time out of his day to attack a 16 year old trans student…"
features.rationale: The post uses multiple ellipses and strong exclamations to intensify emotional impact.

features.feature_value: Explicit calls for legal/financial policy change
features.evidence_span: "I think that most police shooting settlements should not be paid."
features.rationale: The speaker directly advocates changing how settlements and liability are handled.

features.feature_value: Blames opposing party actors for violence while contrasting with favored enforcement
features.evidence_span: "Gotta love the GOP DOJ and the NRA influence... And then THEY complain about the Dems"
features.rationale: The language sets up an in-group/out-group contrast (GOP/DOJ/NRA vs Dems) around responsibility for shootings.

features.evidence_span: "Isn’t it hypocritical to take a few Bible verses..."
features.rationale: The sentence is structured as a rhetorical question to frame the target’s stance as inconsistent.

features.feature_value: First-person, observational reportage with concrete actions and quantities
features.evidence_span: "I spent 9 years documenting border wall construction across Arizona. I watched DHS pump millions of gallons"
features.rationale: The post asserts lived documentation and specific observations rather than presenting hypothetical claims.

features.feature_value: Frames a death as caused by hatred toward a religious group and specific political actors
features.evidence_span: "Died a hero, but WOULD be alive if it weren15t for the hatred against Muslims"
features.rationale: The text emphasizes victimization/persecution tied to hate and names political blame targets.

features.feature_value: High density of named political figures and parties
features.rationale: The post relies on multiple specific politicians to direct the accusation.

features.feature_value: Uses moralized, high-emotion framing of an organization
features.evidence_span: "This is the dark truth of Planned Parenthood!"
features.rationale: The language uses a strong moral/emotive label (“dark truth”) to characterize the subject negatively.
